protocol.selection_rule: Promising only if both yaw-direction pooled yaw RMS improve >=10% vs control on both evaluation seeds, no-failure counts do not decrease, and all non-yaw scenario pooled tracking axes remain within .2/.2/.25. Otherwise inconclusive or negative; no automatic promotion.
protocol.acceptance: One checkpoint/seed ablation only. Three controlled seeds, physical randomization, Flat gate still required.
